_source: references/floor-plan.pdf (Karta instalacyjna, Wiszące Ogrody, bud. 18, m. 19, piętro 2). The developer gives no dimensions: 'Wymiary do odczytu wyłącznie ze skali', so every length here is measured from the PDF vector paths against the scale bar.
_coords: Plan coordinates are in PDF points in the displayed (rotated) page space: x grows to the right, y grows DOWN the page. scripts/build_shell.py converts them to metres with Blender X = (x - origin.x) * mm_per_pt / 1000 and Blender Y = (origin.y - y) * mm_per_pt / 1000, so plan-up is +Y.

scale.note: Scale bar 0-3 m measures 170.04 pt, which gives 56.68 pt/m. Nominal 1:50 on A3 would be 56.69 pt/m, so the two agree within 0.02%.

origin_pt.note: Inner south-west corner of the living room.

ceiling.note: Clear room height, confirmed by the owner (2026-10-02). Not printed on the plan.

window_head.note: Not on the plan; NEEDS CONFIRMATION.

living_window_head.note: Living-room glazing head height, set by the owner (2026-10-02). The other windows keep window_head (2.20, assumed).

bedroom_window_sill.note: Plan says 'parapet obniżony' (lowered sill) with a low radiator; the height is not given. NEEDS CONFIRMATION.

balcony_floor_offset.note: Balcony slab is usually a step below the interior floor; not on the plan.

floor_above_grade.note: 2nd floor: ground floor raised ~0.3 m plus two storeys of ~3.25 m (2.95 m clear + slab). Not on the plan; only drives the view outside.

orientation.note: Direction of true north in the Blender frame, degrees counter-clockwise from +X. Read from the compass rose on the developer's arrangement plan (Hossa, 'Propozycja aranzacji', flat 19): north points to the lower left of the drawing, so the balcony and the bedroom window face south-east (bearing ~134 deg).

storey.note: II pietro (2nd floor above the ground floor), per the developer plan.

walls.note: Installation shaft: sewer stack, ventilation and the hood duct inlet.
Installation shaft behind the washing machine and sink area.

openings.note: 2.60 m wide unit: a left fixed pane (~0.85 m) and a pair of inward-opening balcony doors (~0.84 m leaves). The plan doesn't say whether the fixed pane runs to the floor; it is modelled full height.

openings.head: window_head

openings.head: interior_door
openings.note: Label 90/210. The gap between the partition and the bath wall is 0.95 m, with a ~0.09 m jamb stub drawn on the left. Modelled as 0.90 m against the right side.

openings.head: interior_door
openings.note: Label 90/210; the swing is drawn into the hall.

rooms.name: Living room + kitchen + hall
rooms.note: The hall is open to the living room and runs from the bedroom door down to the entrance.

fixtures_reference._note: Utility points from the installation plan, kept for furnishing. They are not architectural geometry.

radiator_living.note: 'grzejnik wyższy' (taller radiator) next to the balcony door.

light_outlets._note: Light outlets from the installation plan legend: 'wypust sufitowy' (ceiling, circle with a cross) and 'wypust scienny' (wall). Centres measured from the PDF vectors; the letter is the switch circuit. data/lighting.json hangs the fixtures on these points.

E1.room: bathroom, east wall above the basin (the symbol is drawn at 720.0, 549.32, its wall is x 750.4)

_swing_dir: swing_dir is the direction the leaf opens into, in Blender axes (+X right, +Y plan-up).
